composition.serve_who: This sheet ("+24V DC DISTRIBUTION", GMMS 108'-111) is a 24V DC distribution schedule for two panels (AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS, FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS), plus an EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY panel and an EMERGENCY PANEL/GMDSS sub-panel. Each breaker row names a discrete load; per the class rule, each load is attributed to the equipment its name identifies, with the panel providing the supply (fed via breaker Qxx/QExx/CBx <rating> from AFT/FWD/EMERGENCY panel). The panels themselves, the 24V service supply bus, F5-F8 fuses/switches feeding SW6-SW9 (bilge/fire pump/tender winch pre-panel switching), CT7/CT8/CT9/CT10 current transformers, the B&G relay (Re/), and the T/S E terminal strip are shared infrastructure/monitoring elements and are attached to the DC Distribution Panels infrastructure node, not to individual equipment.

facts: Sheet defines the 24V DC distribution scheme across AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS, FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS, EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY panel, and EMERGENCY PANEL (with GMDSS sub-breakers CB7/CB8).

24V SERVICE SUPPLY bus (left side) is fed via fuses F5 (100A), F6 (200A), F7 (60A), F8 (60A) and an unlabeled ~50A fuse, feeding switches SW6-SW9 and an unlabeled switch SW? which pre-switch the Bilge Pump, Fire Pump and Tender Winch loads before the main panel bus.
CT8 current transformer sits on the 'to ONYX' feed line near the top of the AFT panel, providing a status tap to ONYX monitoring, not a power path.
A small relay (coil labeled Re/, contact labeled B&G) sits between breaker rows Q49/Q50 and the B&G supply, providing an auxiliary switched path.
Text legend defines CTB7 = QI-POWER-485-300-LV; CTB8, CTB9, CTB10 = QI-POWER-485-LV (network/bus interface module identifiers for panel monitoring, not equipment loads).
Emergency battery (+24V EMERGENCY BATTERY) feeds the Emergency Power Supply panel via CT7 (see DWG 111a) and also feeds 'to ONYX'.
Diamond callouts '4' and '6' near EMERGENCY LTS / T/S E terminal and near bottom right (toward FWD panel) are wire-gauge cross-reference tags, not equipment.
GMDSS sub-panel breaker CB7 (6A) row is unlabeled/marked '/' — no confirmed load.
